fact: At a 12 February 2025 meeting PPDAA told the AfDB mission the website and Tender Portal were finalised in January 2025 and that bidding opportunities, awards and provider registration can be done through the portal.
title: AfDB Supervision Mission on NoRMA-1 and ISP-EG Projects Holds Meeting with PPDAA Team led by the PPDAA's Executive Director Hon. Deng Akuei Kak
publisher: Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Authority (PPDAA)
